entries.title: FDA approval: Juvmo
entries.summary: To treat Parkinson’s disease in adults

entries.title: FDA approval: Lyrfigtu
entries.summary: To adults with previously treated unresectable, locally advanced or metastatic cholangiocarcinoma harboring a fibroblast growth factor receptor 2 gene fusion or other rearrangement

entries.title: FDA approval: Onswik
entries.summary: To improve glycemic control in adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus, as an adjunct to diet and exercise

entries.title: FDA approval: Isembyld

entries.title: FDA approval: Tauklarify

entries.title: FDA approval: Orzeyful
entries.summary: To treat narcolepsy type 1

entries.summary: To treat attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder

entries.summary: To treat patients with neovascular (wet) age-related macular degeneration

entries.title: FDA approval: Jideytro

entries.title: FDA approval: Cypsedo

entries.title: FDA approval: Baxfendy

entries.summary: To treat adults with relapsed or refractory mantle cell lymphoma after at least two lines of systemic therapy, including a Bruton’s tyrosine kinase inhibitor

entries.title: FDA approval: Awiqli

entries.title: FDA approval: Adquey
entries.summary: To treat mild to moderate atopic dermatitis

entries.title: FDA approval: Zycubo
entries.summary: To treat Menkes disease Drug Trials Snapshot
